title: wedelia serrulata
intro: Wedelia serrulata, commonly known as the yellow daisy or serra wedelia, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of Wedelia serrulata include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic, making it a potential remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Wedelia serrulata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
